name: Beginnings
summary: In Dun Morogh, Alamar Grimm tests Alliance warlock novices before teaching them to summon an imp. First, they must take feather charms from Frostmane troll novices.

sections.title: A Reluctant Mentor
sections.body: Influential voices have noticed a recruit with promise, and their attention draws Alamar Grimm from his occult research. Though reluctant, the warlock comes to assess the novice.

sections.title: The Spark of Dark Magic
sections.body: Before teaching a novice to enslave lesser demons, Grimm demands proof of endurance and magical affinity. Frostmane troll novices carry feather charms in a cave southwest of Anvilmar. Subtle primal magic runs through the charms, and taking them proves the novice can overcome a magical foe. The curious specimens also serve Grimm's research.

sections.title: Summoning the Imp
sections.body: The charms persuade Grimm that the novice has the will to survive. He teaches the summoning of an imp, a warlock's most basic minion. Its chaotic fire magic can overpower a master who lacks discipline.

faq.answer: Alamar Grimm gives the trial. He trains warlocks inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What are the feather charms used for?
faq.answer: The feather charms prove an aspiring warlock can face and defeat magically adept enemies. These enchanted troll trinkets also give Alamar Grimm curious specimens for his research.

faq.q: Where are the Frostmane novices located?
faq.answer: Frostmane troll novices gather in a cave southwest of Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. The Frostmane trolls have established a presence there.

faq.q: What reward does a warlock gain upon completing this task?
faq.answer: The trial earns Alamar Grimm's approval and teaches a warlock to summon an imp, their first demonic companion.

faq.q: Why is Alamar Grimm teaching new warlocks?
aliases: who told alamar to train me
faq.answer: Influential voices take an interest in the fledgling warlock. Their attention persuades Grimm to pause his private occult studies and test and mentor the recruit.

faq.q: Is the imp dangerous for a novice warlock?
faq.answer: Yes. Alamar Grimm warns that an imp's small size hides volatile fel fire and cunning. An inexperienced summoner can easily be overpowered.

angles.text: As an Alliance warlock in Dun Morogh, you begin your craft by earning Grimm's approval and learning to summon your first demonic servant.
As a gnome warlock learning your craft in Coldridge Valley, you prove your intellect and command of magic by outsmarting the local Frostmane trolls.
